# Calling Required Packages

```{r}
# Callning package
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(magrittr)
library(readxl)


```


# Import old RLE files

```{r}

# Import data file and select for Tanzania
Fish_NCRA <- read_excel("../../../data_raw/WIO_GCRMN_fish_data_all_levels_Feb_2020.xlsx", 
    sheet = "WIO_GCRMN_fish_data_all_levels_")

Fish_NCRA<- Fish_NCRA[Fish_NCRA$Country =="Comoros", ] # filter for Comoros

Fish_NCRA2<- Fish_NCRA[Fish_NCRA$level1_code=="serra" | Fish_NCRA$level1_code=="scari",]

# Import Geofile and select for Tanzania
Geo_file<-read.csv(file = "../../../../Ecological-Research-Data-Analysis/1. Data processing/Template files/Overall_Geo-file_Updated.csv" ,header = TRUE)

Geo_file<- Geo_file[Geo_file$Country =="Comoros", ] 


```


# Standardising Sites names

```{r}

# Checked for unmatched site names
h<-match(Fish_NCRA2$Station,Geo_file$Proposed_Station,nomatch = 0)
unique(Fish_NCRA2$Station[h==0])

Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected<-Fish_NCRA2$Station

# Make corrections
Fish_NCRA2%<>%
  mutate(Station_corrected = Station_corrected %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Bwana_Iddi` = "Bwanaidi",
                      `Mirereni` = "Mereni",
                      `Sambia_West` = "Sambia_Reserve",
                       Chin_02 = "Chindini",
                       Barakani = "Itsandra", 
                       Moindzaza = "Moindzzaza",
                       Shom1 = "Shomoni"
                      ))



Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    Station_corrected = case_when(
      Site_id == "Comoros,Anjouan,A"         ~ "Mtsaka",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Grand_Comore,A"    ~ "GC_A_P_SC05",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Moheli,A"          ~ "Point Ouani",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Anjouan,B"         ~ "Habwanajibou_01",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Grand_Comore,B"    ~ "MW_E_P_SC10",
      Site_id %in% c("Comoros,Moheli,B_-_N", "Comoros,Moheli,B_-_S") ~ "Djirani",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Moheli,D"          ~ "Mea",
      Site_id == "Comoros,Moheli,E"          ~ "Ferenga",
      TRUE                                    ~ Station_corrected  # Keep existing if no match
    )
  )


# Add other columns
Fish_NCRA2$site_corrected<-Geo_file$Proposed_Site[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]
Fish_NCRA2$Location<-Geo_file$Proposed_Location[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]
Fish_NCRA2$Sector<-Geo_file$Proposed_Sector[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]
Fish_NCRA2$Management_level<-Geo_file$Management_level[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]
Fish_NCRA2$Latitude<-Geo_file$Latitude_old[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]
Fish_NCRA2$Longitude<-Geo_file$Longitude_old[match(Fish_NCRA2$Station_corrected, Geo_file$Proposed_Station)]

# Fills other blanks fields
#Sector
Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    Sector = case_when(
      Station_corrected %in% c("Shom1") ~ "Grand Comore",
      Station_corrected %in% c("Point Ouani", "Djirani") ~ "Moheli Island",
      TRUE ~ Sector  # keep existing value if not matched
    )
  )

# Site
Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    site_corrected = case_when(
      Station_corrected %in% c("Shom1") ~ "Shomoni",
      Station_corrected %in% c("Djirani") ~ "Djirani",
      Station_corrected %in% c("Point Ouani") ~ "Point Ouani",
      TRUE ~ site_corrected  # keep existing value if not matched
    )
  )


# Management level
Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    Management_level = case_when(
      Station_corrected %in% c("Shom1","Djirani","Point Ouani") ~ "Open access",
      TRUE ~ Management_level  # keep existing value if not matched
    )
  )


# Latitude
Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    Latitude = case_when(
      Station_corrected %in% c("Shom1") ~ "-11.64467",
      Station_corrected %in% c("Djirani") ~ "-12.28323",
      Station_corrected %in% c("Point Ouani") ~ "-12.24682",
      TRUE ~ Latitude  # keep existing value if not matched
    )
  )

# Longitude
Fish_NCRA2 <- Fish_NCRA2 %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = case_when(
      Station_corrected %in% c("Shom1") ~ 43.395,
      Station_corrected %in% c("Djirani") ~ 43.6221,
      Station_corrected %in% c("Point Ouani") ~ 43.65845,
      TRUE ~ Longitude  # keep existing value if not matched
    )
  )


# Add Sub-national
unique(Fish_NCRA2$Location)
Fish_NCRA2$`sub-national`<- Fish_NCRA2$Sector

# Add Eco-region
Fish_NCRA2$Eco_region<-Fish_NCRA2$`sub-national`

Fish_NCRA2$Organization <- "CORDIO"

# Starndise family names
Fish_NCRA2%<>%
  mutate(fish_name = fish_name %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Scarinae` = "Scaridae",
                      `Epinephelidae`     = "Serranidae"))

# Management
Fish_NCRA2%<>%
  mutate(Management_level = Management_level %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Partially Restricted` = "Partially restricted"))



```


# Format current CORDIO Data 2022-2024

```{r}

Fish_current <- read.csv("../../../data_raw/Fish_site_summary_families_all-years.csv")

# Check Site naming
# Checked for unmatched site names
m<-match(Fish_current$Site,Geo_file$Proposed_Site,nomatch = 0)
unique(Fish_current$Site[m==0])

# make any corrections
Fish_current%<>%
  mutate(Site = Site %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Memboimboini` = "Memboiboini",
                      `Mitsamiuli`     = "Mitsamiouli"))

# Add other columns
Fish_current$Sector<-Geo_file$Proposed_Sector[match(Fish_current$Site, Geo_file$Proposed_Site)]
Fish_current$`sub-national`<- Fish_current$Sector
Fish_current$Eco_region<-Fish_current$`sub-national`

# Select for Groupers and Parrotfish
Fish_current<- Fish_current[Fish_current$Family=="Epinephelidae" | Fish_current$Family=="Scarinae",]

Fish_current$Organization <- "CORDIO"



```


# Format current DAHARI Data 2022-2024
```{r}

Fish_DAHARI <- read.csv("../../../data_raw/Fishabundance_Site_families_mean_DAHARI.csv")


# Checked for unmatched site names
k<-match(Fish_DAHARI$Site,Geo_file$Proposed_Site,nomatch = 0)
unique(Fish_DAHARI$Site[k==0])

# Add other columns
Fish_DAHARI$Sector<-Geo_file$Proposed_Sector[match(Fish_DAHARI$Site, Geo_file$Proposed_Site)]
Fish_DAHARI$`sub-national`<- Fish_DAHARI$Sector
Fish_DAHARI$Eco_region<-Fish_DAHARI$`sub-national`


# Select for Groupers and Parrotfish
Fish_DAHARI <- Fish_DAHARI[!is.na(Fish_DAHARI$Family) & 
                            Fish_DAHARI$Family %in% c("Epinephelidae", "Scarinae"), ]

Fish_DAHARI$Organization <- "DAHARI"

# Management
Fish_DAHARI%<>%
  mutate(Management_level = Management_level %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Partially Restricted` = "Partially restricted"))


```



# Merge the three Dataset



# Format and saving output file

```{r}

# Check columns names on both files
names(Fish_NCRA2)
names(Fish_current)
names(Fish_DAHARI)

# Format for issues


# Format for Issues
# old dataset
names(Fish_NCRA2)[names(Fish_NCRA2)=="fish_name"]<-"family"

#New dataset
# CORDIO current
Fish_current$Station <- Fish_current$Site
Fish_current$Station_corrected <- Fish_current$Site
Fish_current$site_corrected <- Fish_current$Site
names(Fish_current)[names(Fish_current)=="Family"]<-"family"
names(Fish_current)[names(Fish_current)=="Mean_density"]<-"density.ind.ha."
names(Fish_current)[names(Fish_current)=="sd_d"]<-"sd_density"
names(Fish_current)[names(Fish_current)=="Mean_biomass"]<-"biomass.kg.ha."
names(Fish_current)[names(Fish_current)=="sd_b"]<-"sd_biomass"

# DAHARI dataset
Fish_DAHARI$Station <- Fish_DAHARI$Site
Fish_DAHARI$Station_corrected <- Fish_DAHARI$Site
Fish_DAHARI$site_corrected <- Fish_DAHARI$Site
names(Fish_DAHARI)[names(Fish_DAHARI)=="Family"]<-"family"
names(Fish_DAHARI)[names(Fish_DAHARI)=="Mean_density"]<-"density.ind.ha."
names(Fish_DAHARI)[names(Fish_DAHARI)=="sd_d"]<-"sd_density"
names(Fish_DAHARI)[names(Fish_DAHARI)=="Mean_biomass"]<-"biomass.kg.ha."
names(Fish_DAHARI)[names(Fish_DAHARI)=="sd_b"]<-"sd_biomass"


# Order columns
# Old
Fish_NCRA3<-Fish_NCRA2[,c("Country","sub-national","Eco_region",  "Year", "Management_level", "Sector", "Location","Site", "site_corrected", "Station", "Station_corrected","family", "density.ind.ha.","sd_density","biomass.kg.ha.","sd_biomass","Organization")]

#New
Fish_current2<-Fish_current[,c("Country","sub-national","Eco_region",  "Year", "Management_level", "Sector", "Location","Site", "site_corrected", "Station", "Station_corrected","family", "density.ind.ha.","sd_density","biomass.kg.ha.","sd_biomass","Organization")]

#DAHARI
Fish_DAHARI2<-Fish_DAHARI[,c("Country","sub-national","Eco_region",  "Year", "Management_level", "Sector", "Location","Site", "site_corrected", "Station", "Station_corrected","family", "density.ind.ha.","sd_density","biomass.kg.ha.","sd_biomass","Organization")]


# Merge two files
Fish_NCRA_complete <- rbind(Fish_NCRA3, Fish_current2, Fish_DAHARI2)

# Rename sub-National and Ecoregion
Fish_NCRA_complete%<>%
  mutate(`sub-national` = `sub-national` %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Mwali`    = "Moheli island",
                      `Mwali`    = "Moheli Island",
                      `Ngazidja` = "Grand Comore",
                      `Ndzuani`  = "Anjouan Island"))

Fish_NCRA_complete%<>%
  mutate(Eco_region = Eco_region %>% factor() %>%
           fct_recode(`Mwali`    = "Moheli island",
                      `Mwali`    = "Moheli Island",
                      `Ngazidja` = "Grand Comore",
                      `Ndzuani`  = "Anjouan Island"))

# Order by years
Fish_NCRA_complete <- Fish_NCRA_complete %>%
  arrange(Year, Site)

# Round vaues to 2 decimals
Fish_NCRA_complete <- Fish_NCRA_complete %>%
  mutate(
    `density.ind.ha.` = round(`density.ind.ha.`, 2),
    sd_density = round(sd_density, 2),
    `biomass.kg.ha.` = round(`biomass.kg.ha.`, 2),
    sd_biomass = round(sd_biomass, 2)
  )

# Save output file

save(Fish_NCRA_complete, file = "../../../data_intermediate/Fish_NCRA_dataset_2025.RDA")

write.csv(Fish_NCRA_complete,"../../../data_intermediate/Fish_NCRA_dataset_2025.csv",row.names = F)


```
